q2_gaps: eventualities internal to a narrative work — 'the climactic battle of the Mahabharata takes place …' describes what happens in an epic, and the instruction set has no intensional routing for story-internal events, so the battle and its location are asserted as plain fact
notes: The light-verb rule is applied correctly — 'takes place' reifies no separate event and the battle-noun witness carries `Location` directly — and the bare simple present rightly gets no status atom. `(PartOf sk_battle_1 mahabharata)` for an episode of a work is a stretch of PartOf's two stated jobs (object component, group member) but follows the genitive part-whole test; likewise `(Member kurukshetra battlefield)` reads 'the battlefield of Kurukshetra' as the Brindle-estuary kind atom rather than an of-genitive, which is the simpler faithful reading.
